title: Theme
description: The YAML frontmatter of themes/<theme_id>.md. The markdown body below the frontmatter holds the human readable evidence list and is not part of this schema. run_id is the StoreFrontmatter field and always equals last_updated_run; both are present so one frontmatter reader serves every stored file. Verify horizon, stated once: stale is true when (build date minus last_verified) is greater than 14 days. status is quiet when score_inputs.recency_days is greater than 14 and status is not filed. stale_reason is null when stale is false. proposal_id is <week>/<theme_id> and is null until the editor proposes the theme. filed_issue_url is null until a human runs approve.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document. Bump minor for an additive change, major for a breaking one.

title.description: Must not contain a pipe character or a newline; the index line is a markdown table row.

aliases.description: Other names the same capability or problem goes by. This is how the post-acquisition vocabulary problem is solved.

distinct_customers.description: Count of distinct account_ids on this theme whose account_type is customer.

distinct_prospects.description: Count of distinct account_ids whose account_type is prospect.

arr_sum.description: Sum of arr_usd across the distinct customer accounts. Prospects contribute zero.

open_cases.description: Sum of open_case_count across the distinct customer accounts, capped at 4 by the formula.

recency_days.description: Whole days between as_of and the newest evidence claim date. Zero when evidence landed today.

high_importance_count.description: Count of evidence claims with importance high.

score_inputs.description: The seven inputs to the score formula. A reviewer can recompute score from these alone.

rationale.description: Written by the editor model, grounded only in the listed evidence.
